mainEntity.name: What types of exercises are included in the BabeFit Program?

acceptedAnswer.text: The BabeFit Program incorporates a variety of functional fitness exercises, including strength training, metabolic conditioning, and bodyweight movements. These exercises are chosen to build practical strength and endurance that translates to daily activities. Process clarity: Workouts typically involve a warm-up, skill or strength component, and a high-intensity conditioning piece, designed to challenge participants progressively.
